name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 2px solid #ffffff focus ring with 1px inner #fff at 80% opacity, the result must deliver a clear and consistent visual indication for keyboard navigation that meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast standards on both light and dark backgrounds, and the lead owns the implementation and testing of this focus ring style across all screens and interfaces.
